jobs.title: Senior Technical Program Manager
jobs.description:
This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Senior Technical Program Manager based in Portugal.

As a Senior Technical Program Manager, you will help drive complex initiatives across a fast-moving product and engineering organisation building AI-powered technology. You will own program structure, workback plans, dependency management, operating cadences, and delivery visibility across a defined portfolio of technical programs. Your work will help engineering and product teams stay aligned while moving quickly in an AI-native environment. You will partner closely with engineering leads and product managers to deliver platform releases, integrations, migrations, and cross-functional initiatives. The role combines strong program management discipline with enough technical fluency to navigate architecture, APIs, integrations, and engineering trade-offs. You will also play an important role in shaping scalable TPM practices, templates, and operating norms. This is a remote EMEA position with regular collaboration and overlap with a London-based hub.

Accountabilities

Establish and maintain an effective operating cadence across your area, introducing the minimum structure needed to keep teams aligned and decisions moving without unnecessary bureaucracy.
Ensure key decisions are made on time, involve the right stakeholders, and are documented clearly so there is a reliable record of what was decided and why.
Support recurring engineering rhythms such as planning, standups, retrospectives, and demos.
Own workback plans and dependency maps for a portfolio of releases, integrations, migrations, and cross-team engineering initiatives.
Maintain accurate project tracking and visibility across tools such as Linear, ensuring issues are properly labelled, estimated, assigned, and kept up to date.
Provide trusted views of production issues, in-flight work, blocked items, and overall program health so stakeholders can access status without relying on additional meetings.
Identify technical, delivery, and timeline risks early; challenge unrealistic assumptions and enforce readiness gates before external commitments are made.
Lead complex programs end-to-end, coordinating multiple teams through scope definition, sequencing, delivery, trade-offs, and stakeholder communication.
Manage cross-team dependencies and handoffs, resolving blockers directly with the relevant leads and preventing avoidable escalation to senior leadership.
Apply a clear escalation framework to distinguish between programs that are on track, at risk, or require leadership decisions.
Coordinate the first response to incidents and client-related interruptions within your area, ensuring issues are routed appropriately without unnecessarily disrupting engineering teams.
Translate technical realities, risks, and constraints into clear updates for non-technical stakeholders, while ensuring engineering teams understand business and delivery expectations.
Maintain a concise and reliable portfolio view for leadership and the wider TPM function, adapting the level of detail to the situation.
Produce clear weekly written status updates that give stakeholders and leadership visibility into program progress, risks, dependencies, and decisions.
Support product and engineering leaders with OKR tracking and reporting, keeping objectives and key results current and turning progress into clear, readable rollups.
Contribute to the development of TPM practices, documentation, templates, cadences, and trackers that can be adopted across the wider organisation.
Measure success through reliable operating rhythms, trusted program plans, timely delivery, early risk identification, reduced unnecessary escalations, and sustainable program-management practices.

Requirements

6+ years of experience in Technical Program Management, ideally within AI/ML, platform infrastructure, developer tooling, or similarly technical environments.
Demonstrated experience managing complex programs involving multiple teams, dependencies, and challenging external deadlines.
Strong technical fluency, with the ability to understand system architecture and discuss APIs, integration design, technical dependencies, and platform trade-offs confidently without needing to be the engineer making the technical decisions.
An engineering background is highly valued, particularly for candidates who have transitioned from engineering into technical program management.
Strong analytical and organisational skills, with the ability to turn ambiguous requirements, incomplete specifications, and competing stakeholder perspectives into clear plans and recommended paths forward.
Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to provide concise executive updates, detailed dependency information for technical leads, and appropriately scaled communication depending on the audience.
Strong judgment around prioritisation, escalation, risk management, and stakeholder alignment.
A proactive, hands-on approach to resolving blockers and coordinating teams rather than relying on hierarchical escalation.
Comfort working in a developing TPM function and contributing to the creation of processes, templates, standards, and operating norms.
Experience working in a high-growth scale-up environment is a plus.
Experience in an organisation that both builds infrastructure and uses that infrastructure for real customer workloads is also advantageous.
Ability to work effectively in a remote environment across EMEA time zones, with regular collaboration and overlap with colleagues in London.

Benefits

25 days of paid time off plus public holidays, supported by a Flexible Time Off approach.
Health insurance and private medical coverage.
Monthly stipend supporting wellness, fitness, and learning and development.
Fully remote working from anywhere in your home country within EMEA.
Enhanced parental leave for birth, adoption, or surrogacy.
Access to an office in The Shard in London.
Flexible working hours.

How Jobgether Works

We use an AI-powered matching process
to ensure your application is reviewed quickly, objectively, and fairly against the role's core requirements. Our system identifies the top-fitting candidates, and this shortlist is then shared directly with the hiring company. The final decision and next steps (interviews, assessments) are managed by their internal team.

We appreciate your interest and wish you the best!

Why Apply Through Jobgether?

Data Privacy Notice:
By submitting your application, you acknowledge that Jobgether will process your personal data to evaluate your candidacy and share relevant information with the hiring employer. This processing is based on legitimate interest and pre-contractual measures under applicable data protection laws (including GDPR). You may exercise your rights (access, rectification, erasure, objection) at any time.

We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, or assessing responses and identifying potential inconsistencies or verification signals in application materials based on available information. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. If you would like more information about how your data is processed, please contact us.

jobs.title: Creative Producer
jobs.description:
About UMBRELLA COLLECTIVE:
Umbrella Collective is an AI-driven Production Company crafting ads, social content for brands that like to stand out. We mix sharp design, clever ideas, and solid craft and we’re looking for a Creative Producer
to join the team.

Role:
As a Creative Producer
, you are the key link between the client, the creative team and the Post-Production team. You take creative ideas and turn them into clear and structured production plans, managing the project from concept development and pre-production through production, post-production, and final delivery.

You are hands-on throughout the entire process, balancing creative ambition with budgets, timelines, production requirements, and client expectations. You ensure that the creative vision remains at the centre of the project while keeping all stakeholders aligned and the production moving forward.

The role requires someone who can confidently move between creative discussions, client communication and post-production workflows. Someone who understands both the big picture and the details needed to make a project happen.

What You’ll Do:

Act as the key liaison between the clients, creative team, and internal teams.
Work closely with agency stakeholders, and the Post-Production team to understand and translate creative concepts into concrete production plans.
Manage projects from initial concept and briefing through pre-production, production, post-production, and final delivery.
Participate in creative and client meetings, helping shape ideas into realistic and achievable production approaches.
Prepare briefs, timelines, budgets, quotations, and presentations in collaboration with the relevant teams.
Coordinate the bidding and production process, ensuring that creative requirements, budgets, schedules, and deliverables are clearly defined.
Work closely with directors, producers, artists, editors, animators, 3D and AI artists, and other creative and technical partners throughout the project.
Keep projects on brief, on schedule, and within the agreed budget.
Continuously monitor project timelines, milestones, deliverables, and client deadlines, proactively identifying and resolving potential issues.
Maintain clear communication between all stakeholders and ensure that relevant information reaches the right people at the right time.
Oversee post-production workflows and ensure that the final output remains aligned with the original creative vision.
Participate in client presentations, reviews, and feedback sessions, translating feedback into clear and actionable tasks for the production and creative teams.
Manage changes, challenges, and unexpected issues with a proactive, solution-oriented approach.
Conduct project debriefs and ensure that project materials are properly documented and archived upon completion.
Identify opportunities to expand the scope of projects and introduce additional production, post-production, content, or AI-driven solutions where relevant.

What You Bring:

Minimum 3 years of relevant experience as an Agency Producer, Project Manager, Account Manager, or in a similar role within a creative agency or production company.
Solid understanding of the advertising and film production process, including concept development, pre-production, production, generative AI and post-production.
Fluent English proficiency; Hungarian is required, German is a plus
Strong project management skills, with proven experience managing multiple projects, deadlines, budgets, and stakeholders simultaneously.
Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to confidently communicate with clients, creative teams, directors, and artists.
Highly organised and detail-oriented, with the ability to keep track of multiple moving parts without losing sight of the bigger picture.
A proactive and solution-oriented mindset. You anticipate challenges rather than simply react to them.
Strong understanding of creative development and the ability to translate creative ideas into realistic production solutions.
Commercial awareness and confidence working with budgets, quotations, production costs, and timelines.
Comfortable working in a fast-paced environment where priorities can change quickly.
Familiarity with post-production and AI workflows and software such as Adobe Premiere Pro, After Effects, DaVinci Resolve, Nuke, Cinema 4D, or Houdini. Just understanding their purpose and workflow without necessarily needing to operate them.
Experience with project management or task-tracking tools such as Monday.com or similar platforms is a plus.
A collaborative mindset and the ability to act as the communication bridge between creative, production, client service, and post-production teams.

Ready to show us what you’ve got?

jobs.title: Bid/Project Manager - German speaking (REF5802R)
jobs.description:
Company Description

As Hungary’s most attractive employer in 2025 (according to Randstad’s representative survey), Deutsche Telekom IT Solutions is a subsidiary of the Deutsche Telekom Group. The company provides a wide portfolio of IT and telecommunications services with more than 5300 employees. We have hundreds of large customers, corporations in Germany and in other European countries. DT-ITS recieved the Best in Educational Cooperation award from HIPA in 2019, acknowledged as the Most Ethical Multinational Company in 2019. The company continuously develops its four sites in Budapest, Debrecen, Pécs and Szeged and is looking for skilled IT professionals to join its team.

Job Description

Department and Project

This position is within the Tolling Services team of Deutsche Telekom IT Solutions Hungary. The team consists of IT professionals specializing in electronic road-charging solutions. Together with our partners, we develop and operate intelligent, kilometer-based tolling systems for international customers, covering the entire business process (vehicle registrations, country booking, providing On-Board Units, position data transmission, charge calculation, and fleet billing). Leveraging digital intelligence and advanced technology, our tolling solutions facilitate seamless mobility across Europe. The team aims to enhance existing services and expand into new domains. As part of an international team collaborating with T-Systems International, you will play a key role in supporting our customers with cutting-edge tolling solutions.

Main tasks

As a Bid / Project Manager
, you will play a key role within our agile organization in the New Business Tribe
. You will be responsible for the end-to-end management of complex tenders and proposals (bid management) and will support awarded projects through their initial delivery phase. Combining strategic thinking, structured execution, and excellent sales and stakeholder management skills, you will actively contribute to business success in the field of road user services and tolling systems.

As a Bid/Project Manager:

Lead and manage tender processes (RFPs) from initial analysis through final proposal submission, including coordination of all internal and external stakeholders.
Develop and consolidate commercial and technical proposals, including business plans, cost calculations, effort estimates, and pricing models.
Ensure the quality, completeness, and timely delivery of all bid documentation.
Collaborate closely with Sales, Legal, Finance, and Delivery teams.
Lead and coordinate cross-functional teams throughout the bid process.
Transition awarded projects to Delivery and provide initial project management support during the implementation phase.
Identify, assess, and manage risks throughout the bid process and early project lifecycle.
Identify market opportunities and growth potential while actively supporting new business acquisition initiatives.
Proactively engage prospective customers, build sustainable customer relationships, and develop new business opportunities across the entire solution sales funnel.

What Sets You Apart

High level of ownership and entrepreneurial mindset.
Ability to communicate complex concepts clearly, persuasively, and effectively.
Hands-on mentality combined with strong strategic thinking.
Confident and professional in dealing with demanding stakeholders.

Why This Role Is Exciting

Direct impact on business growth and commercial success.
Opportunity to work on complex international projects.
Unique combination of strategy, sales, and project management responsibilities.
Dynamic environment with high visibility and significant influence on business outcomes.

Qualifications

Qualifications

Background and required skills:

University degree (minimum Bachelor's level), preferably in Business Administration, Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field.
More than five years of experience in bid management and project management, ideally within IT and infrastructure environments.
Proven experience managing complex tenders, preferably in the public sector.
Strong sales and customer orientation, combined with excellent communication skills and a solid understanding of sales and decision-making processes.
Demonstrated success in acquiring new customers, expanding market opportunities, and converting business opportunities into signed contracts.
Excellent ability to structure complex topics, manage stakeholders, and coordinate interdisciplinary teams.
Experience with complex technical solutions is advantageous, although expert-level technical knowledge is not required.
Excellent communication skills in both German and English; French language skills are considered a plus.
Strong team player with a collaborative mindset.
Willingness to travel (approximately 25% to 50%).

Additional Information

Please be informed that our remote working possibility is only available within Hungary due to European taxation regulation.

new_jobs.description:
Company Description

As Hungary’s most attractive employer in 2025 (according to Randstad’s representative survey), Deutsche Telekom IT Solutions is a subsidiary of the Deutsche Telekom Group. The company provides a wide portfolio of IT and telecommunications services with more than 5300 employees. We have hundreds of large customers, corporations in Germany and in other European countries. DT-ITS recieved the Best in Educational Cooperation award from HIPA in 2019, acknowledged as the Most Ethical Multinational Company in 2019. The company continuously develops its four sites in Budapest, Debrecen, Pécs and Szeged and is looking for skilled IT professionals to join its team.

Job Description

Department and Project

This position is within the Tolling Services team of Deutsche Telekom IT Solutions Hungary. The team consists of IT professionals specializing in electronic road-charging solutions. Together with our partners, we develop and operate intelligent, kilometer-based tolling systems for international customers, covering the entire business process (vehicle registrations, country booking, providing On-Board Units, position data transmission, charge calculation, and fleet billing). Leveraging digital intelligence and advanced technology, our tolling solutions facilitate seamless mobility across Europe. The team aims to enhance existing services and expand into new domains. As part of an international team collaborating with T-Systems International, you will play a key role in supporting our customers with cutting-edge tolling solutions.

Main tasks

As a Bid / Project Manager
, you will play a key role within our agile organization in the New Business Tribe
. You will be responsible for the end-to-end management of complex tenders and proposals (bid management) and will support awarded projects through their initial delivery phase. Combining strategic thinking, structured execution, and excellent sales and stakeholder management skills, you will actively contribute to business success in the field of road user services and tolling systems.

As a Bid/Project Manager:

Lead and manage tender processes (RFPs) from initial analysis through final proposal submission, including coordination of all internal and external stakeholders.
Develop and consolidate commercial and technical proposals, including business plans, cost calculations, effort estimates, and pricing models.
Ensure the quality, completeness, and timely delivery of all bid documentation.
Collaborate closely with Sales, Legal, Finance, and Delivery teams.
Lead and coordinate cross-functional teams throughout the bid process.
Transition awarded projects to Delivery and provide initial project management support during the implementation phase.
Identify, assess, and manage risks throughout the bid process and early project lifecycle.
Identify market opportunities and growth potential while actively supporting new business acquisition initiatives.
Proactively engage prospective customers, build sustainable customer relationships, and develop new business opportunities across the entire solution sales funnel.

What Sets You Apart

High level of ownership and entrepreneurial mindset.
Ability to communicate complex concepts clearly, persuasively, and effectively.
Hands-on mentality combined with strong strategic thinking.
Confident and professional in dealing with demanding stakeholders.

Why This Role Is Exciting

Direct impact on business growth and commercial success.
Opportunity to work on complex international projects.
Unique combination of strategy, sales, and project management responsibilities.
Dynamic environment with high visibility and significant influence on business outcomes.

Qualifications

Qualifications

Background and required skills:

University degree (minimum Bachelor's level), preferably in Business Administration, Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field.
More than five years of experience in bid management and project management, ideally within IT and infrastructure environments.
Proven experience managing complex tenders, preferably in the public sector.
Strong sales and customer orientation, combined with excellent communication skills and a solid understanding of sales and decision-making processes.
Demonstrated success in acquiring new customers, expanding market opportunities, and converting business opportunities into signed contracts.
Excellent ability to structure complex topics, manage stakeholders, and coordinate interdisciplinary teams.
Experience with complex technical solutions is advantageous, although expert-level technical knowledge is not required.
Excellent communication skills in both German and English; French language skills are considered a plus.
Strong team player with a collaborative mindset.
Willingness to travel (approximately 25% to 50%).

Additional Information

Please be informed that our remote working possibility is only available within Hungary due to European taxation regulation.
